raw_text: Keep `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md` mirrored. Extend overrides, not `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`; CSS: `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; media: `svg/`/near Markdown; generated `public/`/`resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Use Hugo Extended v0.120+. Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Verify `public/search/index.json` in Chromium/Firefox. Include regenerated `public/`; focused imperative commits. PRs list paths, issues, screenshots/zipped previews, and build status.
